columns.name: noc_queue
columns.reason: The NOC queue that owns the site and receives the alarm is set by routing rules at ticket creation.

columns.name: antenna_vendor
columns.reason: Installed equipment vendor recorded in the site asset inventory long before the outage.

columns.name: band_plan
columns.reason: Spectrum configuration of the site is fixed in advance and known at alarm time.

columns.name: truck_rolls_dispatched
columns.reason: Counts field dispatches made in response to the outage, so it keeps incrementing until restoration.

columns.name: postevent_alarm_count
columns.reason: Explicitly a post-event tally, only final after the outage has been worked and closed.

columns.name: shelter_model
columns.reason: Physical shelter type is a fixed site asset attribute.

columns.name: rectifier_model
columns.reason: Installed power plant model is recorded in the equipment inventory before any outage.

columns.name: restoration_minutes
columns.reason: The realized outage duration itself, which is exactly what the 4-hour target is derived from.

columns.name: sla_credit_usd
columns.reason: Credit is calculated after restoration from the achieved downtime, so it does not exist at prediction time.

columns.name: district_code
columns.reason: Static geographic assignment of the site.

columns.name: feeder_reliability
columns.reason: Historical reliability rating of the serving utility feeder, maintained ahead of any given event.

columns.name: permit_zone
columns.reason: Regulatory zone of the site, established at build and stable thereafter.

columns.name: access_road_class
columns.reason: Standing description of how the site is reached, known before dispatch.

columns.name: site_elevation_m
columns.reason: Fixed geographic property of the site.

columns.name: battery_age_months
columns.reason: Derivable from the recorded battery install date at the moment the alarm is raised.

columns.name: lightning_density
columns.reason: Climatological rate for the site's location, sourced from historical data rather than the event.

columns.name: backhaul_vendor
columns.reason: Transport provider under contract for the site is known before the outage.

columns.name: region_group
columns.reason: Static organizational grouping of the site.

columns.name: security_tier
columns.reason: Standing site security classification held in the site record.

columns.name: landlord_type
columns.reason: Property ownership category comes from the existing ground lease.

columns.name: sector_count
columns.reason: Configured number of sectors is part of the site build record.

columns.name: zoning_class
columns.reason: Municipal zoning of the parcel is fixed well before the event.

columns.name: fuel_contract
columns.reason: Standing fuel delivery agreement for the site, in place before any outage.

columns.name: escalation_tier
columns.reason: Reads as the site's pre-assigned escalation class, though it could instead be the tier the incident later reached.

columns.name: guy_wire_flag
columns.reason: Structural property of the tower, fixed at construction.

columns.name: spares_depot
columns.reason: Depot assigned to serve the site under standing logistics mapping.

columns.name: grounding_spec
columns.reason: As-built electrical grounding standard recorded in site documentation.

columns.name: tower_height_band
columns.reason: Physical dimension of the structure, fixed and recorded.

columns.name: climb_permit_class
columns.reason: Standing permit category governing climbs at the site, established in advance.

columns.name: tower_class
columns.reason: Structure type is a permanent attribute of the tower.

columns.name: power_utility
columns.reason: Serving electric utility is fixed by the site's location and service account.

columns.name: hvac_model
columns.reason: Installed cooling equipment recorded in the asset inventory.

columns.name: crew_base
columns.reason: Home base of the field crew responsible for the site under standing territory assignment.

columns.name: generator_runtime_index
columns.reason: Reads as a standing index of generator duty history for the site, not runtime accrued during this outage.

columns.name: market_code
columns.reason: Static market assignment of the site.

columns.name: lease_expiry_band
columns.reason: Derived from the existing lease end date, known before the event.

columns.name: fence_type
columns.reason: Physical compound feature recorded at build.

columns.name: cabinet_model
columns.reason: Installed outdoor cabinet is part of the fixed site equipment record.
